category_basis: Ensor died 19 November 1949; the Belgian term (life+70) expired in 2020. Every work shown predates 1930, so each is public domain in both Belgium (life+70) and the US (pre-1930 publication). One file (skeletons_herring.jpg) is a museum photograph under CC BY-SA 4.0 of a public-domain painting — fine for personal use with attribution.
